pledge: To always choose you in every lifetime, in every universe.
To laugh with you on sunny days and hold you close through every storm.
To preserve our memories, tenderly and faithfully, in endless orbit.
To listen to your heartbeat when words are not enough.
To celebrate every September 24 milestone with the same wonder as day one.
To hold your hand gently through every step and chapter of our story.
To be your warmest sanctuary, your quiet peace, and your eternal best friend.

To keep our love sacred, pure, and bound by infinite cosmic gravity.
